schema.title: Response List Activities Api V1 Activities Get

post.description:
Upload up to 20 activity files in one request.

Each file is processed independently — a failure on one does not roll back
the others. Dedup is handled by the same ``upsert_upload`` source-hash
mechanism as the single-file endpoint, so re-uploading a previously stored
activity yields ``status: "duplicate"`` rather than an error.

get.description:
Download a single activity as a FIT or TCX binary.

Returns 404 if the activity does not exist at all, 403 if it exists but
belongs to another athlete, and 400 for an unsupported ``format`` query
parameter. GPX is intentionally unsupported (out of scope).
